• What volunteers will be doing
• What they will learn

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.a1: Ecobilda is a platform connecting volunteers with eco-construction and permaculture projects worldwide. Learn sustainable skills while helping eco-friendly communities.
gettingStarted.q2: How do I create an account?
gettingStarted.a2: Click on "Register" in the top navigation, fill in your details including name, email, date of birth, and password. Once registered, you can start browsing and applying to projects.
gettingStarted.a3: Yes, creating an account and browsing projects is completely free. Some project hosts may have specific requirements or fees, which will be clearly stated in their project description.

forVolunteers.title: For Volunteers
forVolunteers.a1: Use the Projects page to browse all available opportunities. You can filter by location, project type (Permaculture or Natural Building), and required skills.
forVolunteers.q2: What should I bring to a project?
forVolunteers.a2: Each project has different requirements. Check the project details page for specific information about what to bring, accommodation provided, and work expectations.
forVolunteers.a3: Yes! After completing a project, both volunteers and hosts can leave reviews. This helps build trust in our community.

forHosts.title: For Hosts
forHosts.q1: How do I create a project?
forHosts.a1: Once logged in, click on "Create Project" and fill in all the details about your project, including description, location, required skills, and work conditions.
forHosts.q2: How many volunteers can I host?
forHosts.a2: You can specify the maximum number of volunteers when creating your project. You can also set different limits for male and female volunteers if needed.
forHosts.q3: Can I edit my project after publishing?
forHosts.a3: Yes, you can edit your project details at any time from your profile. Make sure to keep the information up-to-date for potential volunteers.
